verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is a mobile MFA, passkey and credential app, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from MCP servers is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI, agent or MCP-client capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
